steps.agent_thought: The user wants me to extract the date and time from the file, format it as "2026-09-08 10:00:00", and convert it to a POSIX timestamp.

tool_input_args.name: command
tool_input_args.value:
# Extract date and time, reformat, and convert to POSIX timestamp
date_str=$(grep -oP '(?<=Date:\s{6})\w+, \w+ \d+, \d+' docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt)
time_str=$(grep -oP '(?<=Time:\s{6})\d+:\d+' docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt)
formatted=$(date -d "$date_str $time_str" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
echo "Formatted: $formatted"
posix=$(date -d "$formatted" '+%s')
echo "POSIX timestamp: $posix"
